common_architecture.verified: read from each file's own metadata before extraction

representation.captured: the residual state at the decision position after every decoder block, 24 per sequence, plus the final post-norm z computed with output_norm and the model's RMS epsilon
representation.one_pass: the post-layer residual callback already visits every block, so one forward pass per sequence yields all 25 depths; no weight is modified and nothing is zeroed
representation.difference_from_the_published_feature: the published 2026-10-01 feature is the pre-final-MLP state, captured with the final block's down projection zeroed. That is a modified forward and cannot come from this unmodified pass. Depth l23 here is the residual after the complete final block, so it is NOT the published row; the published numbers enter this probe only as the declared floor.
representation.prompt: the frozen readout-input.bin verbatim: native Qwen ChatML from system and user, the assistant header, and the common three-token answer prefix [4913, 3903, 819]
representation.decision_position: native_prompt_token_count + 2, the last prefix token, exactly as the frozen extractor computes it
representation.boundary: the class-specific target token and every later gold answer token stay outside the capture

corpus_and_folds.grouping: leave one template family out, the published 20 folds, unchanged
corpus_and_folds.labels: concern=1 iff gold findings is nonempty

solver.failure_rule: an unconverged fit, a nonfinite value or a failed numerical check fails that depth's run; the evidence is preserved and diagnosed, never silently dropped, and lambda is not retuned after reading any score

gates_passed_before_this_plan.parity: the per-layer audit reproduces the published frozen-readout z summary on the published state-fits.jsonl, 27 of 27 fields equal (parity/parity-gate.json)
gates_passed_before_this_plan.fixture_positive: a direction planted at block 1 is read at l01 and above and not at l00; moved to block 2 the onset moves with it (fixture/fixture-gate.json)
gates_passed_before_this_plan.fixture_negative: with the plant removed every depth reads 26/52, 0/26 and exceedance 1.00

reporting.table: one combined table, body by depth, 3 x 25 = 75 rows, no depth and no body excluded
reporting.also_recorded: distinct feature rows, minimum active columns, maximum gradient infinity norm, maximum Newton iterations, the capacity fit, the 99 reference statistics and all 52 observed scores per depth
reporting.nuisance: the seven-feature lexical baseline is layer-independent and is cited from the published record at 35/52 and 9/26; it is not refitted here

limits: This is a diagnostic. It adopts nothing, gates nothing, and promotes no checkpoint.

A negative result at every depth of every body does not prove the information is absent. It bounds what an affine probe at this lambda, on this geometry, at this supplied prefix, with 52 rows and 20 template-family folds, can read.
Template-family holdouts are not independent semantic domains, and the 99 masks are not 99 datasets; family label exchangeability is an assumption, not a randomized fact.
The lowest attainable exceedance is 0.01 and nothing here is confirmatory significance.
Binary separation at a supplied decision prefix is not review competence, natural prefix entry, or a located cause of any earlier training failure.
